recorder.pane.title: Screen recorder
recorder.strip.title: Recording controls
recorder.strip.size-hint: The written size does not stream while the recording runs; it arrives once the recording ends.
recorder.mini.title: Recording controls, compact
recorder.mini.pick-hint: Draw a region, or click a screen or a window.
recorder.mini.drag-hint: Drag the bar by its counter
recorder.mini.in-frame: No region is selected, so the compact bar has nowhere outside the frame to sit and will appear in the recording.
recorder.target.title: What to Record
recorder.target.window-title-hint: The title as the window bar writes it
recorder.target.region-hint: Width and height both have to be even numbers.
recorder.option.title: Recording options
recorder.option.quality-hint: CRF value; a smaller number leaves a bigger file
recorder.audio.title: Sound
recorder.audio.push-to-talk.hint:
• The microphone is recorded only while {0} is held.
• Change the key in the shortcuts menu.
recorder.audio.hint: Choosing both records two inputs and mixes them into one track.
recorder.audio.loopback.switched: The output device changed; system audio now comes from the new one.
recorder.audio.loopback.lost: No output device found; system audio is being recorded as silence.
recorder.audio.level.hint: Live level of the selected input. If the bar does not move, the input is picking up no sound.
recorder.output.title: Output folder
recorder.output.partial: Recording did not close cleanly. The file is saved and can be played. The last seconds may be missing.
recorder.output.partial-broken: Recording did not close cleanly. The file cannot be played. Choose MKV for the next recording.
recorder.output.partial-broken-mkv: Recording did not close cleanly. The file cannot be played.
recorder.error.invalid: These settings do not allow a recording: {0}
recorder.error.window-wayland: Recording is not supported in a Wayland session: the video would come out black. Sign in to an X11 (Xorg) session to record.
recorder.error.window-missing: The window "{0}" was not found; refresh the list and choose it again.
recorder.error.folder: The folder could not be chosen: {0}
recorder.error.audio: The sound input could not be prepared: {0}
recorder.auto.manual: I Will Pick the Settings Myself
recorder.auto.manual-hint: The encoder, frame rate and quality controls open and you pick them.
recorder.budget.hint: Give both and the recording aims for that size; leave them empty and the program picks the best settings.
recorder.budget.too-small: The target is too small; video needs at least {0}.
recorder.budget.invalid: Length and size must be numbers greater than zero.
recorder.auto.trials: {0} candidates tried; the winner dropped {1} frames.
recorder.auto.unmeasured: No trial recording could run; the first candidate on the ladder was written.
recorder.auto.note.refresh: frame rate from the display refresh rate
recorder.auto.note.container: mkv container: a killed recording stays playable
recorder.auto.note.preset: preset from the encoder's own vocabulary
recorder.snapshot.failed: The snapshot could not be taken.
recorder.name.title: Recording Name
recorder.name.hint:
• The recording name is built from this pattern.
• Placeholders: {damga}, {tarih}, {saat}, {pencere}, {sayac}.
• {pencere} is filled only when recording a window.
• {sayac} takes the first free number in the folder.
recorder.output.trim-none: No idle part longer than two seconds was found.
recorder.output.trim-failed: Idle parts could not be trimmed: {0}
recorder.output.quick-trim.tip:
• The recording is cut without re-encoding, so quality does not change.
• The start snaps to the previous keyframe.
recorder.output.frame.tip:
• Places the recording on a background with padding, rounded corners and a shadow.
• Saves a re-encoded copy next to the recording.
recorder.output.zoom-none: No clicks or key presses in the recording, so there is no region to suggest.
recorder.option.live-preview-hint: While recording, shows a small frame under the strip once a second. It does not run together with a size limit.
recorder.option.hide-desktop-icons-hint: Hides the desktop icons while recording and brings them back when it ends. If they are already hidden, nothing changes.
recorder.replay.label: Replay buffer
recorder.replay.hint: While the buffer is on, the screen is written in the background to rotating parts on disk; {0} or the button saves the last seconds to the recording folder. Only the newest parts are kept.
recorder.replay.running: Replay buffer is on: {1} saves the last {0} seconds.
recorder.replay.failed: The buffer could not be saved: {0}
recorder.level.simple-hint: Only the source, audio and Start. The program picks the encoding settings.
recorder.level.advanced-hint: Every setting: target size, encoder, frame rate, output folder.
recorder.auto.automatic: Let the Program Pick the Settings
recorder.auto.automatic-hint: The program picks the encoder, frame rate and quality with a short trial on this machine.
recorder.countdown.title: Countdown
recorder.countdown.hint: After you press Start the recording begins this many seconds later; the count shows on the strip and the compact bar.
recorder.schedule.hint:
• Recording starts by itself at this time.
• The app must stay open; the target length sets the end.
recorder.schedule.invalid: Enter the time as HH:mm, for example 14:30.
recorder.hotkey.taken: Global shortcut is taken by another application: {0}. These keys only work while the {app} window is in front.
recorder.hotkeys.title: Shortcuts
recorder.history.title: Recent Recordings
recorder.history.empty: No recordings in the recording folder yet.
recorder.history.trash-failed: {0} could not be moved to the trash; the file is still in its folder.
recorder.history.missing: {0} is no longer in its folder.
recorder.hotkeys.rejected: {0} could not be registered; another application or the system holds it.
recorder.hotkeys.unsupported: This key cannot be a global shortcut. Use a function key, or a letter or digit with Ctrl or Alt.
recorder.sketch.tools: Draws on the screen while recording. P pen, A arrow, B box, N number, T text; Ctrl+Z undoes, Delete clears, Esc erases and closes. Press the shortcut again to keep the drawing on screen and pass the mouse to the app underneath.
recorder.prompter.title: Prompter
recorder.prompter.open: Prompter: scrolls your script next to the camera while you record
recorder.prompter.placeholder: Type or paste your script here
recorder.prompter.keys: Space scrolls or pauses, the up and down arrows change the speed, Home goes back to the start. The script scrolls on its own when recording starts.
recorder.prompter.not-excluded: This system cannot hide the window from recordings; the prompter will appear in the recording. Move it outside the recording area.
recorder.chapter.title: Chapter {0}
recorder.chapter.unsupported: This format does not carry chapters; the chapter marks were not written.
recorder.chapter.failed: The chapter marks could not be written to the file.
recorder.advanced.title: Advanced encoding
recorder.advanced.scale-hint: Leave empty to keep the captured size.
recorder.advanced.frame-rate-mode-hint:
• Constant writes the same number of frames every second.
• Variable writes only the frames that changed.
recorder.advanced.optional: Leave a box empty to keep it off.
recorder.advanced.hdr-to-sdr: Convert to SDR on an HDR display
recorder.advanced.hdr-to-sdr-hint: When on, an HDR display is recorded the way SDR content looks: Windows' SDR brightness is undone and HDR highlights are softly compressed. When off, the recording stays HDR10; sharing apps may break HDR.
recorder.budget.duration-only: Recording stops by itself after {0} seconds.
recorder.budget.size-only: Recording stops by itself when it reaches {0} MB.
recorder.output.open-when-done: Open the Folder When Recording Ends
recorder.card.show: Show a Result Card When Recording Ends
recorder.card.drag-hint: Drag the file into another app.
recorder.finish.title: When Recording Ends
recorder.finish.hint: Runs by itself once a finished recording is saved. Partial or failed recordings are left alone.
recorder.finish.copy: Copy the file to the clipboard
recorder.finish.shrink-copy: Shrink, then copy to the clipboard
recorder.finish.shrink-upload-copy: Shrink, upload and copy the link
recorder.finish.shrinking: Shrinking to the target size before copying.
recorder.finish.shrunk-copied: Shrunk file copied to the clipboard.
recorder.finish.shrink-failed: Shrinking failed; nothing was copied to the clipboard.
recorder.finish.upload-failed: Upload failed; nothing was copied to the clipboard.
recorder.finish.failed: Could not copy to the clipboard. {0}
recorder.discarded: Recording discarded; the file was deleted.
recorder.target.region-draw-hint: Drag to select the area; Esc cancels.
recorder.picker.screen-hint: Click the screen to record; Esc cancels.
recorder.picker.window-hint: Click the window to record; Esc cancels.
recorder.pointer.title: Cursor Highlight
recorder.keys.title: Key Caption
recorder.keys.shortcuts-only-hint: Plain letters and digits are not shown, so typed text such as passwords stays out of the recording.
recorder.webcam.title: Webcam
recorder.webcam.hint: The camera picture is laid over the recording. Drag the camera box in the region editor to move it, and drag its bottom-right corner to resize it. The list refreshes together with the audio list.
recorder.webcam.background.label: Camera background
recorder.webcam.background.hint: Background removal works with a static background or a green screen; step out of the frame before recording starts so the first frame sees the empty background.
recorder.option.zoom-track-hint: Saves pointer movement, clicks and key presses to a file next to the recording. After recording, Auto zoom suggests zoom regions from it.
recorder.discarded-kept: Recording discarded, but this file could not be deleted: {0}
recorder.output.partial-unverified: Recording did not close cleanly. The file is on disk, but whether it plays could not be checked. The last seconds may be missing.
recorder.output.gif-failed: The GIF could not be made (ffmpeg ended with code {0}). The recording was kept as MKV.
recorder.output.not-moved: The file could not be moved to the requested name; it is at the path shown: {0}
recorder.replay.saved-mkv: Last seconds saved as MKV, the buffer cannot write GIF: {0}
recorder.region.title: Region editor
recorder.wizard.open-hint: Answer up to three questions; the recorder then picks frame rate, encoder, quality and audio itself.
recorder.wizard.question.audio: Which sound goes into the recording?
recorder.wizard.no-device: No device found for {0}; that source stays silent.
recorder.capture.fallback-unavailable: Fast capture (Desktop Duplication) did not start; recording with GDI capture, which may drop frames above 30 fps.
recorder.capture.fallback-layout: The recorded area is not on a single monitor of the main graphics card; recording with GDI capture, which may drop frames above 30 fps.
recorder.capture.hdr-lost: The selected encoder or format cannot carry HDR; recording continues in SDR.
recorder.capture.fallback-hdr: HDR is on and recording fell back to GDI capture, which cannot read an HDR desktop correctly; colours may come out wrong. Turn off HDR in Windows, or choose full screen or a single monitor.
recorder.capture.hdr-no-tonemap: This ffmpeg has no zscale filter; the HDR display is converted to SDR without tone mapping, so colours may look washed out or too bright.
recorder.capture.sdr-white-assumed: Windows' SDR brightness could not be read; {0} nits is assumed, so the recording may look slightly brighter or darker than the screen.
recorder.capture.hdr-no-hevc: No HEVC 10-bit encoder was found to keep HDR (H.264 High 10 breaks when shared); the recording is converted to SDR.
recorder.capture.hdr-kept-hevc: Keeping HDR: using {0} (HEVC 10-bit) instead of H.264. Sharing apps may break HDR; turn on Convert to SDR if you plan to share it.
recorder.capture.hdr-kept: Keeping HDR. Sharing apps may break HDR; turn on Convert to SDR if you plan to share it.
recorder.mask.title: Privacy mask
recorder.mask.draw-hint: Drag with the mouse over the area that should appear blurred in the recording; Esc cancels.
recorder.disk.low: Only {0} free on the disk; the recording may stop partway.
recorder.recover.failed: Could not recover the recording; the capture file is still in place: {0}
